name: DCx Limitations and Constraints
definition: Current implementation allows non-manifold vertices formed by the intersection of up to 6 surfaces (e.g., the anchor point of Case 8). Topologies with more branches may degenerate into multiple non-manifold vertices.
summary: DCx Limitations and Constraints describe the topological and resolution boundaries of the DCx isosurface extraction method, which cannot guarantee manifold surfaces without post-processing unlike SDFs.
